title: Maeterlinck's 'The Cloud That Lifted' foretells the Kennedy assassination

tellings.quote: Because the same guy who wrote that wrote a play called The Cloud That Lifted.

plain: A play called The Cloud That Lifted, by the Belgian writer Maurice Maeterlinck, author of The Blue Bird, is said to foretell the 1963 killing of John F. Kennedy in Dallas. The author Peter Levenda brings this up with Michels without naming a source, noting that "the same guy who wrote that wrote a play called The Cloud That Lifted," and he ties it to Lee Harvey Oswald. He does not say in the telling what in the play matches the assassination, so the link is left as his reading.
